title: Control4 outage after maintenance restart; unverified industry claims point to rogue software on dealer controllers
date_note: ChannelNews (published 25 November) says the Control4 maintenance operation began on 24 November.
geo_basis: The article gives no location for Control4 or the affected customers.
summary: ChannelNews reports connection problems for Control4 OS 3 and X4 owners and Composer Pro dealers after a maintenance operation that began on 24 November. A company update said only that systems had been restarted. ChannelNews relays unverified industry claims of unapproved software on controllers; it says neither Snap One nor Control4 has confirmed a ransomware attack.
plain: Control4's smart-home system had connection problems after a maintenance restart. ChannelNews relays unverified claims from industry sources about rogue software on controllers; the company has not confirmed an attack.
exec: ChannelNews reports a Control4 outage after maintenance that affected owners and dealers; unverified insider claims of rogue software are unconfirmed by Control4 or Snap One.

key_findings: Maintenance began 24 November; connection problems followed the restart
Company update: 'Control4 systems have been restarted'
Industry-source claims of unapproved software are unverified by ChannelNews

validation.note: Only ChannelNews read; Control4/Snap One's own status page was not read.

review.note: Compared title, date 24 Nov, claim attribution, no attack confirmation, products and single_source against the ChannelNews article
